title: 2024 domestic road-bike selection: TRINX Tornado 900
notes: Chinese cycling-media launch coverage says the 龙卷风900 launched on 2024-06-22 with a T800 carbon frame, carbon fork, handlebar and seatpost, a full Shimano 105 groupset and CNY 10,980 reference price. It does not publish complete weight, maximum tire clearance or a controlled stiffness assessment.
